title: Wheelchairs - Nomenclature, terms and definitions
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 10976) covers Wheelchairs - Nomenclature, terms and definitions. This Indian Standard ( First Revision ) which is identical to ISO 6440 : 1985 'Wheelchairs — Nomenclature, terms and definitions', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) was adoped by the Artificial Limbs, Rehabilitation Appliances and Equipment for the Disabled Sectional Committee ( MHD 10 ) and approval of the Medical Equipment and Hospital Planning Division Council. The text of ISO standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are however not identical to those used in the Indian Standards. Attention is particularly drawn to the following: Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'. marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
